about: Experience R4 RIDGE RACER TYPE 4® originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
High speed and stylish driving! That's what it takes to become the ultimate Ridge Racer!
The extremely popular PS® game R4 RIDGE RACER TYPE 4 marks its return on PS4® and PS5®!
It is named R4 to indicate the fourth entry in the Ridge Racer series.
The basic gameplay follows the concept of the Ridge Racer series, a racing game where everyone can enjoy the excitement of high-speed control.
In the main game mode, players will be able to experience the life of a racer.
*Bonus Discs (Ridge Racer - High Spec Ver. and Namco Catalogue '98) are not included.

This title has been converted from the PlayStation® version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PlayStation® version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PlayStation® console’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.
summary: Experience R4 RIDGE RACER TYPE 4® originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
